comply.source: Endendijk et al. 2023, Journal of Coastal and Riverine Flood Risk: 75.7% of advised residents left (Limburg 2021)

doorBoost.note: set to 0 until sourced (pessimistic). no study isolates door-to-door. Personal advice raised evacuation from 18.9% to 75.7% (Endendijk 2023); 'no single channel is likely to reach all people' (Pescaroli & Magni 2015)

mob.source: KLD Evacuation Time Estimate, Lee Nuclear Station (NRC ML073510574), Table 5-5: 62% ready by 30 min, 82% by 1 h, 97% by 2 h
mob.note: US nuclear-plant study, not a European flood: replace when a local curve exists

speedCar.source: FLOODsite Evacuation Calculator (c.2009): 'usually an average velocity of 20 km/hour is used' in flood evacuation models; legal limits 50 km/h built-up, 90 km/h outside built-up areas in Wallonia (police.be 2024)
speedCar.note: average speed in evacuation traffic, below legal limits

carDepth.source: AIDR Guideline 7-3 Flood Hazard, 2017 (class H1: ≤0.3 m and ≤2 m/s)

footDepth.source: AIDR Guideline 7-3, 2017 (≤0.3 m generally safe; 0.15 m kept as a conservative limit)

leadMin.note: July 2021 Vesdre: ~0–3 h between alerts and the water (Walloon Parliament inquiry 2022)

sphere.note: humanitarian standard, not a Belgian norm; set in js/places.js

squeeze.note: extra emergency places when a shelter is full

rescueRate.note: no published rate for the Vesdre. 2021 context: fire zone Vesdre-Hoëgne & Plateau ~3,300 missions in 72 h (~46/h, L'Avenir 2022); 9 helicopters rescued 21 people in 42 flight hours (L'Avenir 2021). Ask the rescue zone.

rescueMob.note: rescue starts this long after the first person is in danger

nationalX.note: no source. 2021: Civil Protection ~30 agents and 6 boats at first, then max ~60 staff per day (L'Avenir 2021); ~300 foreign rescuers, 50 boats

shelterShare.note: evidence: ~4.5% went to public centres in Limburg 2021 (Endendijk 2023); Verviers plan 600 beds for ~4,600 people (~13%); 25% keeps a large margin

riverbankM.note: homes this close to the river: upstairs unreliable, evacuate early (houses collapsed along the Vesdre in Pepinster, July 2021)

storey.note: a building has a safe floor if it is at least this much taller than the water

wetProofMaxM.note: above this depth the building alone cannot be protected: buy-out / relocation candidates
